column1: # M5 living coverage matrix (docs/design/m5-planner.md §4.1, emitted at M5-1).
# One row per (shape class × composition state); the router's class list and
# M5-3's suppression probe are asserted against / generated from THIS file —
# "covered" claims and routing flags must not drift apart silently.
#   class           shape class key (stable identifier; §4.1 row)
#   spill_eligible  yes | no | gap:<flag> | na   (§2.4 law 2c: canonical-bytes
#                   text engagements DISABLE the word-mode spill arm; the bytes
#                   spill record is a data-driven gap flag, not a hardcoded rule)
#   topn_composable yes | no | degrade:<arms> | na  (§2.4 law 2b: armed top-N
#                   degrades pass-through and combine-split arms — full drain,
#   adopt_eligible  yes | no | na  (§2.4 law 2a: a SPILLED Local disqualifies
#                   single-Local pass-through AND seal-time table adopt)
#   status          covered | covered-partial | covered-losing | refused | not-covered
#   route_to        runtime | legacy   (the §2.3 suppression flag M5-3 consumes;
#                   flipped per class with review + measurements only)
#   probe_key       M5-3 plan-time probe class (m5_suppress.rs CoverClass) that
#                   keys this row, or "-" when the row is not keyed via a
#                   BOOTSTRAP_MATRIX CoverClass. Two "-" sub-cases since t35
#                   returns None and Gather stands — the bootstrap-narrowing
#                   law; these rows stay route_to=legacy); (b) KNOB-PATH rows
#                   / SE-BARELIMIT): suppression rides the dedicated knob-path
#                   own trace labels + provisional floors, deliberately
#                   route_to=runtime with the flip letter cited in notes
#                   at m5-integration: this column replaces the separate
#                   rows against BOOTSTRAP_MATRIX, and the router's
#                   coverage_matrix_is_consistent pins the schema. A probe
#                   key may span several matrix rows (CbPlainAggFold covers
#                   both cbstore fold rows); all rows sharing a key must
# §2.4 law 1 (spill-armed retained-result), restated as the router contract:
# the retained-emit envelope applies ONLY when spill is DISARMED and is arm-
# internal — the router NEVER pre-refuses on it (regression class: agg e2e
# legs 4/4d/4e, sort-b leg 7, run through the router at every M5 increment).
